title: What If Your Brain Ran at 100%?
description: What would really happen if your brain ran at 100%? Your senses, memory, speed, body and 'superpowers', checked honestly with real science. And at the end: could a 100% brain beat the smartest AI ever built?
sources: Herculano-Houzel 2009 / Azevedo et al. 2009: ~86 billion neurons
Raichle & Gusnard 2002, PNAS: brain ~2% of body mass, ~20% of energy (~20 W)
Lennie 2003, Current Biology: energy cost limits how many neurons can be active at once
Zheng & Meister 2024, Neuron: 'The unbearable slowness of being' (~10 bits/s conscious throughput, ~10^9 bits/s sensory input)
Parker, Cahill & McGaugh 2006; LePort et al. 2012: highly superior autobiographical memory (hyperthymesia)
Purves et al., Neuroscience: conduction velocity up to ~120 m/s
Walter & Carraretto 2016, Int J Hyperthermia: effects of brain temperature
Maguire et al. 2000, PNAS: posterior hippocampus in London taxi drivers
Nagasako et al. 2003, Pain: congenital insensitivity to pain
NINDS: seizures as abnormal synchronous neural activity
Treffert & Christensen 2005, Scientific American: Kim Peek
Csikszentmihalyi 1990, Flow; Dietrich 2004: transient hypofrontality hypothesis
Meta 2024: Llama 3 trained on ~15 trillion tokens
IEA 2025, Energy and AI: data center electricity use
Moravec 1988, Mind Children: what is easy for humans is hard for robots
Kasparov 2010, NYRB: freestyle (centaur) chess
Draganski et al. 2004, Nature: juggling changes grey matter
Luria 1968, The Mind of a Mnemonist (Shereshevsky)
Ward 2013, Annu Rev Psychol: synesthesia
Eagleman 2008, Curr Opin Neurobiol: perceived timing of events
Google DeepMind & OpenAI, July 2025: AI models reach gold-medal standard at IMO 2025

scenes.narration: The machine strikes first. Faster than you can blink.
scenes.image_prompt: dynamic anime battle shot: the AI titan (a towering figure of dark glass panels with glowing amber circuit lines and calm amber eyes) hurling a storm of glowing amber data shards across a night arena toward Kai (a young man with short dark messy hair and a teal hoodie), who stands his ground, wind in his hoodie

scenes.narration: But your brain filters the storm. Out of a thousand signals, you see the one that matters.
scenes.image_prompt: anime close-up of Kai (a young man with short dark messy hair and a teal hoodie) with calm glowing teal eyes, the world around him in slow motion, hundreds of grey shards frozen in the air and a single one outlined in bright teal

scenes.narration: Billions of neurons fire together. You dodge, read the pattern, and learn its rhythm.
scenes.image_prompt: anime action shot: Kai (a young man with short dark messy hair and a teal hoodie) sliding low under a sweeping amber energy beam, teal light trails following his movement, a faint glowing pattern of the attack drawn in the air

scenes.narration: No fear. No doubt. Just flow.
scenes.image_prompt: anime key frame: Kai (a young man with short dark messy hair and a teal hoodie) mid-leap with a calm focused face, landing a clean glowing teal strike on the bright amber core in the chest of the AI titan (a towering figure of dark glass panels with glowing amber circuit lines and calm amber eyes), sparks of light bursting outward

scenes.narration: Then both of you step back. Because this fight isn't decided by one hit. It's decided round by round.
